mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window following FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0% for 2 months) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates housing sector contraction that reduces consumer demand, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decline > 0.5% and HOUST decline > 0.5% (last month)
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negative in >60% of triggered instances (RSAFS and HOUST decline >0.5%) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During early supply shock recessions (indicated by INDPRO < 100), manufacturing output contraction squeezes corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in >60% of INDPRO < 100 instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in <40% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY >4.5% for 3 months) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window following RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market contraction that reduces household income and consumer spending, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline > 0.5% and UNRATE rise > 0.3pp (last month)
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in >60% of triggered instances (PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in <40% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100 for 2 months) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
